summary: Shopify provides a structured path for app development using the Shopify CLI or Dev Dashboard. Developers must manage OAuth, access scopes, and security requirements. Public apps require a formal review process, while custom apps are installed directly by a single organization.

claims.text: The app review process includes the status Submitted.
claims.label: official_docs
claims.evidence_quote: After you submit your public app for review, it moves to the **Submitted** status and you receive an email confirming that your submission was received.

claims.text: The app review process includes the status Paused.
claims.label: official_docs
claims.evidence_quote: If your app doesn't meet core requirements that prevent a reviewer from reviewing your app, then your app moves to the **Paused** status and then you’ll receive an email that outlines required changes.

access_ladder.name: Approved
access_ladder.allows: The app has passed the review process and is ready for public release.
access_ladder.gate: Successful completion of the review process

claims.text: The app review process includes the status Reviewed.
claims.label: official_docs
claims.evidence_quote: If your app requires additional fixes that need to be discussed with your reviewer, then it moves to the **Reviewed** status.

access_ladder.name: Public Marketplace
access_ladder.allows: The app is listed in the store and available to any merchant.

claims.text: A Shopify App Store app is available to any merchant after passing review.
claims.label: official_docs
claims.evidence_quote: Publish your app in the Shopify App Store and any merchant can install it once it passes review.

claims.text: The app review process includes the status Published.
claims.label: official_docs
claims.evidence_quote: After your app has been approved by the app review team, you'll receive an email confirming that your app has moved to the **Published** status and now displays on the Shopify App Store.

claim.text: You need a client ID and client secret from the Dev Dashboard.
claim.label: official_docs
claim.evidence_quote: You have your app's client ID and client secret from the Dev Dashboard.

claim.text: You must add your app's redirect URI to your app's settings in the Dev Dashboard or your shopify.app.toml file.
claim.label: official_docs
claim.evidence_quote: You've added your app's redirect URI to your app's settings in the Dev Dashboard, or to the [auth] section of your shopify.app.toml.

claim.text: You must know which access scopes your app requires.
claim.label: official_docs
claim.evidence_quote: You know which access scopes your app requires.

claim.text: You must have Node.js 18 or higher installed before you install your app.
claim.label: official_docs
claim.evidence_quote: Before you install, make sure you have Node.js 18 or higher.

claim.text: You must review the App Store requirements before submitting your app for public listing.
claim.label: official_docs
claim.evidence_quote: Review the App Store requirements and Theme Store requirements before you submit.

claim.text: Public distribution requires registering for the Shopify App Store.
claim.label: official_docs
claim.evidence_quote: Public distribution also requires registering for the Shopify App Store, which has a one-time fee.

go_public.item: Apps must use session tokens for authentication and function without third-party cookies.

claim.text: Apps must use session tokens for authentication and function without third-party cookies.
claim.label: official_docs
claim.evidence_quote: Your embedded app must function properly without relying on third-party cookies or local storage, including when accessed in incognito mode on Chrome.

go_public.item: Public apps that call the GraphQL Admin API must use expiring offline access tokens.

claim.text: Public apps that call the GraphQL Admin API must use expiring offline access tokens.
claim.label: official_docs
claim.evidence_quote: Expiring offline access tokens are required for public apps that call the GraphQL Admin API.

claim.text: The refresh token expires in 90 days.
claim.label: official_docs
claim.evidence_quote:
refresh_token_expires_in

Seconds until the refresh token expires (90 days).

claim.text: The Customer Account API has a limit of 3,000 requests per minute per customer.
claim.label: official_docs
claim.evidence_quote:
Customer Account API

Cost points per store and customer, plus 3,000 requests per minute per customer

blockers.fix: Reject the request if the state parameter does not match the stored nonce.

claim.text: If the state parameter does not match the stored nonce, reject the request.
claim.label: official_docs
claim.evidence_quote: Compare the state parameter to the nonce you stored in step 1. If they don't match, reject the request.

blockers.fix: Anchor the shop domain pattern at both ends to prevent sending the authorization code to an uncontrolled host.

claim.text: If the shop domain does not match the required pattern, the app must not send the authorization code to the host.
claim.label: official_docs
claim.evidence_quote: Confirm the shop parameter matches ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9\-]*\.myshopify\.com$. Anchor the pattern at both ends. Without the trailing $, a value such as exampleshop.myshopify.com.attacker.example passes the check, and your app sends the authorization code to a host you don't control.

blockers.issue: Submitting an app that does not meet requirements will result in a rejection and a lost…
blockers.fix: Read the requirements before you submit.

claim.text: Submitting an app that does not meet requirements will result in a rejection and a lost review cycle.
claim.label: official_docs
claim.evidence_quote: Read the requirements before you submit, because a rejection costs you a full review cycle.

blockers.issue: You cannot change the distribution method after you have selected it.
blockers.fix: Compare the capabilities and requirements of each type before choosing.

claim.text: You cannot change the distribution method after you have selected it.
claim.label: official_docs
claim.evidence_quote: You can't change the distribution method after you select it.

blockers.issue: Apps that use off-platform billing are prohibited.
blockers.fix: Use Shopify App Pricing or the Shopify Billing API.

claim.text: Apps that use off-platform billing are prohibited.
claim.label: official_docs
claim.evidence_quote: Apps that use off-platform billing cannot be distributed through the Shopify App store, unless you've been notified otherwise by Shopify.

blockers.issue: Apps that bypass checkout or payment processing are prohibited.
blockers.fix: Use Shopify checkout for all transactions.

claim.text: Apps that bypass checkout or payment processing are prohibited.
claim.label: official_docs
claim.evidence_quote: Apps that bypass checkout or payment processing, or register any transactions through the Shopify API in connection with such activity, are prohibited.

blockers.issue: Apps that provide capital funding cannot be distributed through the Shopify App Store.
blockers.fix: Do not build apps that provide capital lending services.

claim.text: Apps that provide capital funding cannot be distributed through the Shopify App Store.
claim.label: official_docs
claim.evidence_quote: Apps that provide capital funding (including but not limited to loans, cash advances, and purchase of receivables) cannot be distributed through the Shopify App Store.

blockers.issue: Apps that connect merchants to external agencies and developers cannot be distributed…
blockers.fix: Do not build apps that connect merchants to external agencies or freelancers.

claim.text: Apps that connect merchants to external agencies and developers cannot be distributed through the Shopify App Store.
claim.label: official_docs
claim.evidence_quote: Apps that connect merchants to agencies and freelancers cannot be distributed through the Shopify App Store.

claims.text: Use client credentials grant if the app only acts on stores in your own organization.
claims.label: official_docs
claims.evidence_quote: If your app only acts on stores in your own Shopify organization, use the client credentials grant instead. It skips the merchant authorization flow.

claims.text: Online access tokens are tied to the staff member session, while offline tokens persist across sessions.
claims.label: official_docs
claims.evidence_quote: Online access tokens are tied to the staff member who opened your app, and their lifespan is limited to that user's session.
